process_chars_node: process a LaTeX characters node into text parts and flush to the document
process_group_node: process a LaTeX group node, appending text or recursively processing child nodes
macro_node_to_text: convert a LaTeX macro node into its corresponding text representation
nodes_to_text: convert a list of LaTeX nodes into a single plain text string
extract_verbatim_content: extract the content inside a LaTeX verbatim environment by name
